messages:
Maria Gomez: Heads-up — we're standing up a new EU inference account (westeurope) for the dedicated A100 pool. Need help coordinating VNet sizing, Public IP quota for NAT, and a PrivateLink path for Marketplace image pulls. @CloudOps can you assist? :pray:
Jake Patel: +1. What does the current plan look like for CIDR sizing and NAT? Any constraints from the on-prem peering side?
Maria Gomez: We expect 12 subnets for prod/gw/monitoring/training/bastion etc. Current subscription has a /24 VNet. We'll need at least /20 to avoid subnet exhaustion. Also need multiple NAT public IPs because we'll run heavy outbound image pulls and KV traffic — worried about SNAT port exhaustion.
Siva Raman: For A100 fleet, also need vCPU and GPU quota increases. Which SKU are we requesting? ND A100 variants? We should list exact VM SKUs to request from Azure quota.
Maria Gomez: Yes, requesting Standard_ND96asr_A100_v4 (or the closest regional SKU). Target initial capacity: 8 accelerators in the first batch, ramp to 32 in 6 weeks. Also bump regional Public IP quota from 8 -> 32 and increase outbound SNAT ports by adding 3 additional NAT gateway IPs (so total 4).
Ashley Chen: For Marketplace images — peering across subscriptions in this tenant blocks some publisher traffic. PrivateLink for the Marketplace works better: we can create a Private Endpoint in the shared-images subnet and expose it to prod via peering, or use Private Link service in SharedServices. Need subscription IDs and service alias.
Jake Patel: FYI, peering won't auto-forward VPN/PrivateLink traffic. If you want cross-subscription PrivateLink, SharedServices must register endpoint policy or we deploy a Private Link service behind an ILB in the same subscription. Might be faster to give the prod subscription delegated rights to pull from the SharedServices storage account via RBAC.
Maria Gomez: Concrete ask for infra team: 1) Increase VNet CIDR to /20 for subscription XXXXXX. 2) Public IP quota from 8->32 for westeurope. 3) Increase Regional GPU quota to 32 A100-class accelerators (list attached below). 4) Approve creation of Private Endpoint/PrivateLink service for Marketplace image pulls. 5) Add 3 additional NAT public IPs and attach to NAT gateway.
CloudOps: Received. Opening quota/AR tickets now — can you paste the subscription and region values and the SKU list? I'll also add a note about accelerated networking and placement groups for the VMSS.
Maria Gomez: Subscription: sub-prod-eu-001, region: westeurope. SKU list: ["Standard_ND96asr_A100_v4", "Standard_NC24r_A100_v3"] (prefer the first). Attachments: eval plan and cost estimate.
Infra Bot: Deploy ticket #INFRA-4931 created for VNet resize and NAT IPs. Quota request #CLOUD-2857 opened for Public IP. GPU quota request #CLOUD-2858 opened. Linking tickets to subscription sub-prod-eu-001.
Siva Raman: Also watch out for VMSS scale limits and regional core quotas. I'll open a parallel request to increase cores by 512 in westeurope to be safe.
Ashley Chen: One more: since we're adding multiple NAT IPs, update the routing table to prefer NAT gateway with hitless change. Also add health probe for PrivateLink service.
Jake Patel: Example az commands for the NAT pick-up (for CloudOps):
```bash
az network nat gateway ip-config create \
  --resource-group infra-rg \
  --nat-gateway-name inference-nat \
  --name nat-ip-2 \
  --public-ip-address /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/infra-rg/providers/Microsoft.Network/publicIPAddresses/pip-nat-2
```
Maria Gomez: Thanks — please tag me in the quota tickets. If support asks for justification, use: "Dedicated inference fleet for low-latency customer workloads — production SLA and controlled data path; will scale from 8->32 GPUs in 6 weeks." :thumbsup:
CloudOps: Will do. ETA: VNet resize & NAT IPs — 2 business days for approvals, GPU quota — depends on capacity, but requesting expedited review. I'll post updates in this thread. :eyes:
Maria Gomez: Great, thanks everyone. Keep me posted on support ticket numbers and any blockers.
CloudOps: Noted. I'll ping here with ticket links and support contact within 1 hour.
